content.title: Why Estée Lauder (EL) Stock Is Up Today
content.summary: Shares of beauty products company Estée Lauder (NYSE:EL) jumped 6.4% in the afternoon session after Goldman Sachs upgraded the stock to 'Buy' from 'Neutral' and raised its price target.

content.title: Goldman Sachs upgrades Estee Lauder on China rebound, travel retail recovery
content.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs says Estee Lauder is nearing a return to revenue growth and margin recovery after years of underperformance, as it upgraded the cosmetics maker to Buy. The brokerage also upp-ed the price target to $115. Estee Lauder’s sales could begin growing again as soon as the September quarter, with double-digit operating margins returning in fiscal 2027 and beyond.
